svg.aria-label: Sleep and readiness, training load, every workout, 8 notifications, daily AI insight, hourly curves that fill in later
svg.title: Sleep and readiness, training load, every workout, 8 notifications, daily AI insight, hourly curves that fill in later

g.text: Stages, HRV and resting HR against
your own baseline, and a 0-100 score.
Fitness, fatigue and form, ACWR, a
plan for today and a 7-day forecast.
HR zones, laps, route, best efforts,
weather, PTE, EPOC and a calendar.
Your own AI model reads the night
and the training, with advice for today.
Hourly heart rate, steps and energy;
a late watch sync backfills the gaps.
